fr.text: Viego n'a aucune vraie escape. Quand son Cœur brisé (R) et son Flash sont down, il est faible : CC-le et prends le fight.
Viego est faible avant le lvl 6 et gank rarement sans avantage. Dès son lvl 6, ses ganks deviennent dangereux : joue plus safe.
Si tu le vois charger sa Gueule spectrale (Z), recule : plus il charge, plus le stun est long, et il touche le premier ennemi.
Son Cœur brisé (R) cible le champion au plus bas % de PV et frappe plus fort selon les PV manquants : ne fight pas Viego low HP.
Chaque possession le heal d'un % des PV max de sa cible. Après un kill, ne le crois pas low : il revient souvent bien plus haut.
En possession, il récupère les sorts du mort. Dans un corps de tank il devient solide, dans celui d'un ADC il devient facile à tuer.
Dans la brume de son Chemin tourmenté (E), il est camouflé, plus rapide et attaque plus vite : ne va jamais l'y chercher seul.
Sa Lame du roi déchu (A) et ses possessions le heal beaucoup. Des Blessures graves sur lui réduisent fortement sa tenue en fight.

en.text: Viego has no reliable escape. Once his R and Flash are on cooldown he's weak: lock him down with CC and take the fight.
Viego is weak pre-6 and rarely ganks without an edge. Once he hits level 6, his ganks get scary, so play safer.
If you see him charging Spectral Maw (W), back off: the longer the charge, the longer the stun on the first enemy hit.
Heartbreaker (R) hits the lowest % HP champion and scales with missing health. Don't fight Viego while you're low.
Every possession heals him for a chunk of his victim's max HP. After a kill, don't assume he's still low.
While possessing, he takes the dead champ's spells. In a tank's body he's sturdy; in an ADC's body he's easy to burst.
Inside the Harrowed Path (E) mist he's camouflaged with bonus move and attack speed. Never walk in there alone to chase him.
Blade of the Ruined King (Q) and possessions give him lots of healing. Grievous Wounds on him cuts his fight sustain hard.
